fusions.name: Royal Bolt
fusions.desc: Raises a bolt that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your allies strike 20% harder for 12 seconds when it hits.

fusions.name: Startling Decree
fusions.desc: A sudden stamp that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Raised Head
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Alert Bearing
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
